messages.author: e582d0b8f8713970
messages.subject: Table of Contents
parts:
Hey ShinyApp Devs,

I couldn't be happier with shinyapps.io and Shiny in general, so thanks for all the incredible work you've put in!

I just noticed that the Table of Contents on one of my Shiny Documents doesn't work (when deployed to shinyapps.io).  Clicking any of the links just reloads the page.  I've got a password on that app, so I'm not sure if that's what's causing problems or if the problem persists when the app isn't password-protected.

I don't really need a table of contents for this project, but I thought I'd let you guys know, in case you weren't aware.

Thanks!
-Jamie
